name: seated_figure4_stretch
prompt: Seated figure 4 stretch: Sit upright at edge of office chair with tall spine, cross right ankle over left knee creating a 4 shape, hinge gently forward at hips with flat back, hold to open hip rotators, switch legs

stages.A: Sit upright at the edge of your office chair with spine tall.
stages.B: Cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a '4' shape.
stages.C: Hinge gently forward at your hips while keeping your back completely flat.
stages.D: Hold for 30 seconds to open hip rotator, then switch legs.
